notes: Purple is back on the corner lights, as a personal best you have to keep earning. Each corner now holds its own best marks, seeded from your saved reference: beat one and that phase goes purple on the lap you did it, and that mark becomes the benchmark, so the same driving next lap reads green. Beat it again and it is purple again. Braking, turn-in, apex and gas all work this way. Before, purple was measured against a reference that never moved during a session, so beating it once meant purple every lap afterwards, which told you nothing. Green is good, amber is mid, red needs work, purple is you just improved here - expect it to be rarer now, because you are measured against your own best of the session. The Corners window also draws solid colours again: it was 82 % opaque and Tk fades what is drawn on a window as much as the background, so every light came out pale. The panel is still see-through, because that comes from keying out its background colour rather than from the opacity. Includes everything from 0.9.158 onwards: all four braking cases, field events never about your own car and no longer logged twice, brake-point drill results reaching the leaderboard, your desktop kept out of highlight clips, SMART remembering the brake bias you actually ran, the finished video named and findable, the Stint and Corners windows centred on the corner you are approaching, larger text in the Stint and Drill panels, a faster radar, quieter iRacing qualifying, and a chequered flag that waits until you cross the line.
